stem: Which processes of land formation were the student’s models designed to show?

options.label: A
options.text: Erosion by fast-moving water and erosion by wind

options.label: B
options.text: Valley formation by moving water and valley formation by a glacier

options.label: C
options.text: The formation of deltas by slowing water and the formation of oxbow lakes by erosion

options.label: D
options.text: Weathering caused by chemical reactions and weathering caused by temperature changes
